summary: Trained the model on real-world cursive words, with heavier augmentation of real and synthetic words, including mid-word bends in the stem.
Added a language model which evaluates how much possible readings match "normal" Manchu, acting as a soft enforcer of syllable structure and vowel harmony.
Combined, these changes increase accuracy from 34.5% to 61.5% on cursive in a hand the model never trained on, and from 94.9% to 96.8% on Sun et al.'s printed dataset.
